source: Master Plant Pool accepted-name preflight and regional/statewide Joey Santore photo inventory

selected.name: Chloracantha spinosa
selected.clue: Inspect narrow leaves, spiny stems and composite flower heads, including involucral bracts.

selected.name: Coryphantha echinus
selected.clue: Inspect grooved tubercles, areole spine patterns, flowers and mature fruit.

selected.name: Cylindropuntia imbricata
selected.clue: Inspect cylindrical segmented joints, spines and tubercles, flowers and yellow fruit.

selected.name: Marrubium vulgare
selected.clue: Inspect square woolly stems, opposite wrinkled grayish leaves, and tight white-flowered whorls.

selected.name: Melia azedarach
selected.clue: Inspect bipinnate leaves, toothed leaflets, violet flowers and persistent yellow drupes.

selected.name: Mirabilis linearis
selected.clue: Inspect narrow opposite leaves, floral involucre, tubular flowers and anthocarps.

selected.name: Mirabilis nyctaginea
selected.clue: Inspect opposite leaves, clustered pink flowers, involucres and developing anthocarps.

selected.name: Rhynchosida physocalyx
selected.clue: Inspect alternate leaves, five-petaled mallow flowers and inflated fruiting calyx.

selected.name: Sabal mexicana
selected.clue: Inspect costapalmate leaves, petiole margins, drooping panicles and small round fruits.

selected.name: Sabatia campestris
selected.clue: Inspect narrow opposite leaves, five-parted pink flowers, central eye and stamens.

selected.name: Schinus terebinthifolia
selected.clue: Inspect pinnate leaves, aromatic leaflets, small flowers and clustered red fruits.
